question: Select a real low-side brake MOSFET candidate and determine whether full-on loss alone can qualify it
method: Manufacturer specification review and resistor-limited load-line calculation; no injected motor waveform
stop_condition: Compute full-on comparison and maximum partial-conduction dissipation once; state gate-drive and SOA conditions before further simulation

inputs.rds_condition: VGS=2.5 V, ID=3 A, TJ=25 C; comparison model, not full-temperature guarantee

acceptance: No manufacturing release until actual gate drive, loss of control power, repetitive SOA and board thermal conditions are qualified
